'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Erich Hawbaker LS Massassi Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Erich Hawbaker]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Massassi Base Operations / One In A Million|TA-L-massassibaseoperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' MaMBO #5
* '''Username:''' der junker
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
